description: Issue #839 AC1, with ARITY as the discriminating variable: the two declarations of `scale` take one and two parameters, and the call `scale 1 2` matches only the LATER one. A last-wins override would run and print `2`; a first-wins rule would reach `ol-too-many-inputs`; the ruling's rule reports `ol-duplicate-definition` at the second declaration and runs nothing. A fixture whose two definitions were identical would pass under all three, which is why this one varies what the rule turns on. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.
